findings.surface: save shape gate vs EquipmentBag.indexEquipped (restore mint path)
findings.repro: For a mortal save, persist two equipment entries with distinct instanceIds, both equipped:true on the same slot (e.g. two base_kiem with might+10 mainStat). validateGameSaveShape admits the payload.
findings.mintPath: player.restoreFromSave -> equipmentBag.add each entry -> indexEquipped flips the first same-slot entry equipped=false -> refreshModifiers -> getEquipped() mints modifiers for at most one item per slot.
findings.evidence: tests/architecture/tc16Falsification.qa.test.ts F-TC16-EQ-DUPSLOT: restore mints modifiers for at most one of the dup-slot entries (passes). The admission is tolerable only because indexEquipped self-heals; a shape-level dup-slot bound would close the seam formally but is not required for correctness today.
findings.confidence: high - deterministic runtime evidence both directions

findings.surface: tribulation committedOutcome shape gate vs TribulationOutcomeService.settleOutcome
findings.repro: For a mortal save, persist save.tribulation.committedOutcome {outcome:'victory', targetRealmId:'golden_core', grade:'human', breakthroughType:'normal'} - a victory receipt skipping the qi_refining rung that no writer can produce (start() requires adjacency + canTriggerBreakthrough). validateGameSaveShape admits it (no adjacency bound at the gate).
findings.mintPath: tribulationDirector.restoreRuntime re-presents the receipt slot -> settleOutcome re-derives hiddenDormant, isRealmTransitionEnabled(player.realmId, targetRealmId) and canTriggerBreakthrough(player) before applying victory/defeat -> returns null; realm and grantedRealmPassiveIds unchanged.
findings.evidence: tests/architecture/tc16Falsification.qa.test.ts F-TC16-TRIB-SKIPREALM: settle returns null, realm unchanged, no realm passives minted (passes).
